It also has s calls, F_k<=(s/W)F_{k-1}+O(1), the two-case geometric sum giving O(e^tau), and the fixed-tape parking cost, all as at 1491-1588.

errors.says: Multiplying a target field by a unit modulo q^b costs O(V) when the controls precede the target.
errors.paper: Only multiplication by one of finitely many fixed specified rational units (numerator and denominator prime to q) is claimed to cost O(V). The method splits into c increasing pieces for a fixed integer c, so an arbitrary unit modulo q^b is not covered.

errors.says: Each of the l chunk rounds is one simultaneous layer, costing O(Tp d^{lambda'}) per round and O(Tp l d^{lambda'}) in total.
errors.paper: The rounds on chunks are the qK rounds at positions h=l-2..b, and the remaining at most b+1 rounds are done individually on prefix slots. The total O(Tp l d^{lambda'}) holds because there are at most l rounds, not because there are l chunk rounds.

errors.says: The ring convolution has error E_ring:=M(3L+2)<5TL, using a symbol L.
errors.paper: Here L=log_2 T (line 4552), which bounds sqrt2 l. The plan never defines this L, and elsewhere (S2.1.5.1) L denotes the total dimension loss of the labels.

chain: The tree follows the paper's route from start to finish. Two tape procedures built from a fixed network with s<Wm feed the synthetic ring convolution and Gaussian resampling with retained permutations, Bluestein chirp and R-cancellation; then CRT layout, coefficient twist, six-step assembly, exact recovery and the cost table with min margin 2kappa give O(n(lg n)^{1-kappa}). It thins out in the network construction: h=100, N=binom(h,3)^3, m=h^3 and the gate-label table are missing, so nesting and the ratios L/N=100/539 and 101/539 are quoted, not derived. The complex phase interface is stated without its frames, its s_c formula or the endpoint C^{tensor m}, and the resampling identity skips the left-inverse step.

steps.note: The exchange (x,y)->(-y,x) with restored scratch and the triple-intersection cancellation are fully present. The defining quantities are absent: h=100, the indexing of X_a,Y_a by a in T^3, N=binom(h,3)^3 and m=h^3. N appears only as 'the number of data wires per bank' and m only as 'the dimension of the label space'. Marked conservatively.
It has a common invertible frame per gate that commutes with pointwise gates, the implemented operator D_out S_Omega D_in^{-1}, and each edge as a change of frame.

It has nondegenerate subspace labels in a label space of dimension m built from triple indicators, comparable labels on every edge, and only central 3->4 edges decreasing, each by h (P tensor F tensor Q). F^{tensor 3} is not named and the label table is absent.
It has rank(P_V-P_U)=dim V-dim U for nested labels, with the N source edges 2P_{U_a} of rank one as the exceptions.
It has the sum Wm-2N+2L with L=Ich and s_b=W_b m-2N+2L_b+N=W_b m-N+2L_b.
It has L_b/N=100/539 and L_c/N=101/539, both below 1/2, so the deficit N-2L_b>0 and s_b<W_b m.
It has the endpoint difference P_{U_a^perp}-(-P_{U_a})=I_m on X_a and identity minus zero elsewhere, so the bit network applies the shear H<-H+D on every role, scratch rows included.
It has A=E_1 Pi E_2 with exactly a ones, the shear costing exactly a interchanges plus O(V), and s recursive calls per node.
It has children of volume V/W, F_k<=(s/W)F_{k-1}+O(1), s/W<m^tau with tau=1-2^{-50} from eta>20*2^{-50} and log m<20, and F_k=O(e^tau). The exact eta values are not given.

central.summary: The plan reconstructs the central saving almost completely. It has frames, labels with a single decreasing edge type, rank equal to dimension change with N rank-one source exceptions, the budget Wm-2N+2L, L/N<1/2 giving s<Wm, the endpoint identity giving H<-H+D, a calls per rank-a edge, and the recurrence with tau=1-2^{-50}. The one gap is C1: the exchange network's mechanism is present, but the concrete parameters h=100, N=binom(h,3)^3, m=h^3 and the triple-indexed banks are missing.
